listed_quote.quote: Blue Owl Capital Corporation (NYSE: OBDC) and Blue Owl Capital Corporation III (NYSE: OBDE) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement, with OBDC as the surviving company

announcement.quote: Blue Owl Capital Corporation and Blue Owl Capital Corporation III Announce Merger Agreement

outcome_evidence.quote: Blue Owl Capital Corporation (NYSE: OBDC) today announced the closing of its merger with Blue Owl Capital Corporation III ("OBDE"), with OBDC as the surviving company.

deals.notes: Shareholder approvals announced 2025-01-08 (0001628280-25-000948); closing announced 2025-01-13. Several 425s were filed the same day as the 8-K announcement (2024-08-07).
